# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.9.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.9.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We/I take the security of Log Horizon seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in this project, please report it responsibly.

### How to report

Please **do not** open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, please report security vulnerabilities using [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/lnfernux/log-horizon/security/advisories/new) on the repository or contact me directly.

### What to include

When reporting a vulnerability, please provide:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Step-by-step instructions or proof of concept to reproduce the issue
- Affected PowerShell module version and environment details (OS, PS version)
- Any proposed remediation or mitigation

### Response timeline

- We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report as soon as we can. It's open source, I've got stuff to do - I will get to it as fast as time permits.
- We will provide irregular updates on progress toward resolving the issue.
- Once fixed, a patched release and maybe a security advisory will be published.
